name: digiquiz-app-tier
description: DigiQuiz private application tier — all business logic, the only tier that runs SQL. Used by the Path A Docker image.

comments.scope: This manifest is for the Path A container image only. Path B installs its dependencies from the bundle's root package.json instead, and does not install mysql2 at all.
comments.bcryptjs: Pure JS — no C++ toolchain, so the image builds on any architecture.
comments.mysql2: Present here and ABSENT from web-tier/package.json. That asymmetry is the architecture, not an oversight; web-tier/Dockerfile fails the build if a driver ever appears there.
